comparison.objective: Remove exactly one tightly packed toilet roll by its core and stand it in a bin.
comparison.physical_skill: Internal-core grasp, vertical extraction from a packed array, and gentle upright placement.
comparison.success_condition: Exactly one roll in bin, upright and released for 2 s; disturbance, damage, extra removal, or dropping reduces or zeros credit.
comparison.reason: Tests extraction of one chosen packed object via an internal grasp, not simultaneous size-based separation of mixed bodies.
